passwordRules.error: Choose a password that meets every rule.
passwordRules.label: Password rules

split.tagline: Follow a facet, not a person.
split.lead: One account, as many personas as you like.

login.title: Welcome back
login.lead: Log in to pick up where your personas left off.
login.googleOnly: This account logs in with Google.
login.followLead: You opened a follow link. Log in and we'll bring you back to it.
login.passwordChanged: Password changed. Log in with your new password.

signup.title: Create your account
signup.lead: One account, as many personas as you like.
signup.emailTaken: An account already uses this email. Log in instead.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.lead: Enter your account's email and we'll send you a link.
forgot.sentLead: If an account with a password uses <email>{{email}}</email>, a link to reset it is on its way. It works for 1 hour.
forgot.googleNote: Accounts made with Google log in with Google instead.
forgot.sendAgainIn: Didn't get it? Send again in {{seconds}}s

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.expiredLead: Reset links work once, for 1 hour. Ask for a new one.
reset.lead: Pick a password you don't use anywhere else.

verify.wrongCodeLeft_one: That code is wrong. {{count}} try left.
verify.wrongCodeLeft_other: That code is wrong. {{count}} tries left.
verify.expired: This code has expired. Request a new one.
verify.sendFailed: We couldn't send your code. Press Resend to get one.
verify.resent: We sent you a new code.
verify.lead: We sent a 6-digit code to <email>{{email}}</email>. Enter it to finish signing up.
verify.hint: Paste works too. The code is valid for 24 hours.
verify.resendIn: Didn't get an email? Resend in {{seconds}}s

visitor.lead: Flookaa is a home for the channels and communities you belong to. Join as the side of you that fits: your sport self, your work self, your cooking self.

personas.title: Personas
personas.body: Make a persona for each side of you. People follow the persona, never the account behind it.

places.title: Channels and communities
places.body: Every channel and community has its own page, colours and rules. Communities group the channels that belong together.

privacy.title: Privacy you choose
privacy.body: Public, private or only you. Private personas appear anonymous until someone you approve follows them.
